anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak characterized by a low length-to-thickness pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: An obtuse transition angle of approximately 165 degrees between the melon slope and the rostrum.
